$comment: Machine-readable companion to BLUEPRINT.md. The markdown carries the exact DDL and function contracts; this file carries the plan an agent executes. Read both.
name: crf-bodywork-configurator
summary: Static storefront selling a print-ready graphics-kit SVG, custom racewear, and a free ECU tune template for the Honda CRF250L/300L. No accounts, no server, no build step.

SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY.note: Appears in page source by design; with the grants below it can only INSERT.

tables.name: crf_apparel_orders
tables.note: Created only by create-apparel-order through the service role; the database generates id, approval_token, download_token, and pending/unpaid state.

tables.name: crf_config
tables.note: RLS on with zero policies and no grants: service-role only. Holds stripe_webhook_secret, resend_api_key, notify_from, site_base_url, operator_key.

edge_functions.name: stripe-webhook
edge_functions.auth: Stripe-Signature HMAC-SHA256 over `${t}.${rawBody}`, constant-time compare, 300s tolerance

edge_functions.name: create-apparel-order
edge_functions.auth: validated anonymous order payload; service-role insert
edge_functions.note: Recomputes price server-side and returns only the generated order id and approval token.

edge_functions.name: apparel-notify
edge_functions.note: Recipient is customer_email from the authenticated order row, never a browser-supplied address. Approval link is built from crf_config.site_base_url. Sends once. Returns 200 {sent:false, reason:'not_configured'} until resend_api_key, notify_from, and site_base_url exist.

edge_functions.name: admin-orders
edge_functions.auth: shared key compared to crf_config.operator_key by SHA-256 digest
edge_functions.note: Read-only queue view. Selects no token columns. Unset key means no access, not open access.

pages.title: Order desk
pages.note: Unlinked and noindex. Inert until crf_config.operator_key is set.

objects: Payment Link (digital kit) — LIVE mode, active, $39.00 USD, product 'CRF250L Custom Graphics Kit — Digital File'
Webhook endpoint — LIVE mode, enabled, targets the stripe-webhook function, subscribed to checkout.session.completed only
No purchase has ever completed: one session exists and it expired unpaid, so the path is unproven end to end
Static site, archive deploy to POST /api/v1/sites/{id}/builds, multipart field named 'zip'
Deploy an explicit file list, never the whole folder: the legal pages sit in the same directory and must not ship until their four facts exist
The site is deployed by upload and deliberately not linked to the repository: a root netlify.toml belonging to another project would otherwise decide what gets published here
Sending domain required before apparel-notify can send; the only verified domain belongs to another project

steps.note: Already done on the live account: the payment link and webhook endpoint exist in live mode and are enabled. Do not rotate the stored signing secret without cause.
Real card, small amount, refund after. This is the only test that exercises the layers in sequence.
Requires entity, address, contact email and governing law. An agent must leave these blank and report them outstanding.

A2.expect: 4 tables and 2 trigger functions exist; crf_orders is empty

A3.expect: anon holds INSERT on exactly crf_orders and crf_order_files; crf_apparel_orders and crf_config have no anon grant, with crf_config RLS on and zero policies
A3.query: select table_name, privilege_type from information_schema.role_table_grants where table_schema='public' and grantee='anon' and table_name like 'crf%';

A4.expect: six functions ACTIVE; an unsigned POST to stripe-webhook returns 400

A5.expect: Stripe endpoint enabled and reachable; a test delivery is rejected as unsigned, which is correct

A6.expect: one row in crf_config for stripe_webhook_secret, value begins whsec_

A8.expect: order row paid with paid_at and stripe_session_id set; kit-download returns the SVG; a wrong token returns 404

A9.expect: /privacy and /terms are NOT reachable until a human fills the legal facts

invariants.statement: anon holds INSERT only on crf_orders and crf_order_files; it has no privilege on crf_apparel_orders or crf_config
no paid order without a Stripe session id
invariants.check: select id from crf_orders where payment_status='paid' and stripe_session_id is null

invariants.statement: no approved artwork without a review timestamp
invariants.check: select id from crf_apparel_orders where artwork_status='approved' and artwork_reviewed_at is null

invariants.statement: no paid order missing its file
invariants.check: select o.id from crf_orders o left join crf_order_files f on f.order_id=o.id where o.payment_status='paid' and f.order_id is null

invariants.statement: the Stripe webhook secret exists only as a crf_config row
customer reads are keyed on (id, token); a wrong token is indistinguishable from a wrong id
schema changes are additive; narrowing ships after the code that stops using the column
the ECU template never offers an injector that reduces flow while presenting itself as an upgrade, and any injector selection must rescale the fuel map or not exist
an email recipient is read from the order row and a customer-facing link is built from configured values, never from the request

agent_rules: Execute steps in order; a failed assertion is a stop, not a retry loop.
Never add a SELECT grant for anon to make a step easier. If a step seems to need one, the step is wrong.
Never write a secret to a file, an environment variable or a CI variable. The only secret is a crf_config row.
Never invent values for entity, address, contact email or governing law.
Stop and ask if a crf_ table already exists and is non-empty, if Stripe is in live mode during a rebuild, or if an assertion fails twice.
Deploy a staged list of files, not a directory. Publishing a folder wholesale ships whatever else happens to be in it.

known_gaps.item: No trading name decided; the prototype name uses a manufacturer's model designation
Merchant name mismatch: payments run through a Stripe account named Clearmark, which is what buyers see at checkout and on their statement
Legal pages written but unpublished pending four facts
Approval email deployed but inert: needs a verified sending domain, which needs the name
Deploys are not automated: NETLIFY_AUTH_TOKEN is revoked so the Action's push trigger stays off. The site itself is current.
3D on-bike preview is a 2D silhouette; modeller brief written, not commissioned
